: Okay! All set.
lines.zh: : 好了！都办妥了。

lines.en: : Then either ask them now or be forced to listen to me inaccurately guess what they may be for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 那就现在问，不然接下来一整晚你就只能听我瞎猜它们是什么了。

lines.en: : Question one: why are the Kanda sisters behind the counter?
lines.zh: : 问题一：Kanda 姐妹为什么在柜台后面？

lines.en: : You know, I really wish I had an answer to that.

lines.en: : I do. Karin’s annoying need to always ensure that everything goes well kicked in when we walked into the hotel and she realized there wasn’t a receptionist working.
lines.zh: : 我有。我们一走进这家酒店，Karin 那讨人厌的「必须确保一切顺利」的毛病就犯了，因为她发现前台没人值班。

lines.en: : It’s the same thing that happened last year. Tell her to go take a fucking break or something.
lines.zh: : 跟去年一模一样。叫她去他妈休息一下什么的吧。

lines.en: : It’s fine. I think I just work here now. It’s sad that I’ll have to quit my clubs, though. But alas.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我想我现在就在这儿上班了。可惜我得退出社团了。唉，算了。

lines.en: : Question two: why are you holding only one key?
lines.zh: : 问题二：你为什么只拿着一把钥匙？

lines.en: : Because I didn’t realize you were coming and we only have three rooms. Which means that floor one is in one room, floor two is in the other, and you and me are in the third.
lines.zh: : 因为我不知道你要来，而我们只有三间房。也就是说，一楼的住一间，二楼的住另一间，你和我在第三间。

lines.en: scene surprisebjcontest2
: I’d be happy to come stay with you guys as well if-
lines.zh: : 我也很乐意去跟你们一起住，如果——

lines.en: scene surprisebjcontest3

lines.zh: : 是啊，对{i}他们{/i}最好。怎么从来没人关心过{i}我{/i}想要什么？

lines.en: : Don’t worry. As the senior customer relations manager for this hotel, I’ve made sure that Sensei and Imani received a room with two beds.
lines.zh: : 别担心。作为本酒店的高级客户关系经理，我已经确保 Sensei 和 Imani 拿到的是双床房。

lines.en: : I’ve also contacted the custodial staff for a privacy curtain so they will not have to look at each other at any point and we will all go home happy and chaste.
lines.zh: : 我还联系了保洁要了一道隔断帘，这样他们就不用在任何时候看到对方，大家都能清清白白、开开心心地回家。

lines.en: : Talk about an oxymoron.

lines.en: : Any more questions, Senpai? Or are you ready to go be happy and chaste?
lines.zh: : 还有问题吗，Senpai？还是说你准备好去清清白白地开心了？

lines.en: : Talk about an oxymoron.
lines.zh: : 这可真是自相矛盾。

lines.en: scene black

We manage to make it to our room without anyone other than the Kandas seeing us, but it’s clear that most of the girls are still awake judging from the laughter and chatter bleeding through their doors.

: Thanks for the meal.

lines.en: : And as the former captain of the competitive blowjob varsity team, I-

lines.en: : Not me. It’s like 3:00 AM and my jaw hurts, so I’m going home.

: Maybe just a {i}short{/i} second round, then?

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sara.
